source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 48.3 — 'very high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-09-30, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-09-28. 26 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 48, Fraga (stage 20) 47, Logroño (stage 8) 46, Alcanadre (stage 9) 46, Calahorra (stage 10) 43, Candasnos (stage 19) 43. At 'very high' or above: stages [3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 18, 19, 20, 23]. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +8.4 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
